summary: A London letting agency appears to lose landlords to an all capitals page, a stuffed title and bold claims without proof.

findings.problem: The page title appears to be a long string of keywords and phone numbers.
findings.cost: Search results cut it off and a stuffed title looks like spam to landlords.
findings.fix: A short title with the agency name and area.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to shout in capitals with claims such as GUARANTEED RENTS FOR UP TO 5 YEARS and FREE LETTING AND MANAGEMENT.
findings.cost: Big claims without terms or proof make careful landlords walk away.
findings.fix: Plain wording with clear terms and examples.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address and the contact number appears to be an 0844 line.
findings.cost: A free builder address and a premium rate number look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a standard local number.

findings.problem: Text such as Looking for classified ads appears on the page, and no reviews or WhatsApp appear.
findings.cost: Stray text and no proof lose both landlords and tenants.
findings.fix: Named reviews, current listings and WhatsApp.
